title: Mass–Angular-Momentum Inequalities with Trapped and Multiple Horizons
exact_target: For axisymmetric initial data with ADM mass $m$ and total angular momentum $J_\infty$, prove $m\geq\sqrt{|J_\infty|}$ for manifolds with a trapped inner boundary. For multiple black holes satisfying $m\geq\mathcal M_{\mathrm{many}}$, determine the value and parameter dependence of $\mathcal M_{\mathrm{many}}$ and identify the geometric meaning of its minimizer.
